title: The scalar-arrow evaluation is the existing evaluated Chern arrow
statement: For Chern data c [def-sp-tower-class-chern], each line bundle L and level n, applying forgetEvaluatedArrow [def-sp-tower-class-finite] to scalarChernArrow [def-sfb-scalar-chern-arrow] of firstChernR gives exactly mapSingleArrow of finiteForget applied to evaluatedChern. This is recorded as HEq, so the constructed endpoint types are transported explicitly. No normalization hypothesis is needed: it is an identity of the constructions.

source.place: clause (2), evaluation gives the finite Kummer first Chern class; expanded SmoothPurityTowerClasses proof, steps 5--8

proof.text: Unfold the constructed scalarChernArrow, firstChern, forgetEvaluatedArrow and evaluatedChern formulas. Their source isomorphism, scalar map, shift comparison, target comparison, evaluation, target-line isomorphism and finite forgetting occur in exactly the same order. All endpoint transports agree definitionally, so HEq.rfl proves the statement.

lean.statement:
theorem forgetEvaluatedArrow_firstChernR (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (c : Chern l E T) (L : T.Pic) (n : ℕ) :
    HEq (forgetEvaluatedArrow (C := Systems T (Arings l E T))
      (SpTowerShriek.ev l E T n) (finiteForget l E T n) (lineEvaluation l E c n)
      (scalarChernArrow l E c (firstChernR l E c L)))
      (mapSingleArrow (finiteForget l E T n) (2 : ℤ) (evaluatedChern l E c L n))
